name: Surabaya Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon in Surabaya, Indonesia on 2 August 2026, with 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: Surabaya Marathon 2026 takes place on 2 August 2026 in Surabaya, Indonesia, starting from Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya. The event offers four distance options: a full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runner abilities. This makes it a flexible race for both serious marathoners and casual participants.
pros: Flat city-centre route on main roads past Tugu Pahlawan, Jalan Tunjungan and Kota Lama
Seven-hour marathon cut-off and early starts from 4am
18 water stations on the route in 2026
Fast front: 2:29:00 and 2:53:30 won the 2026 marathon, with prize money in open, national and masters divisions
cons: Humid heat: 26°C with a 23°C dew point at the 4am start, 31°C by 11am
Roads must reopen by 11am, so intermediate cut-offs can stop slower marathoners
No usable official route map with aid positions was published
Entries cannot be transferred, refunded or cancelled
research_highlights: The event was first held in 2017 and ran in 2017, 2018 and 2019 before pausing during the pandemic; the 2026 return was initiated by APPBI, the shopping-centre managers' association, with Le Minerale as title sponsor.
2026 edition offers four distances — 5K, 10K, Half Marathon (21K) and Full Marathon (42K) — starting/finishing at Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya on Jl. Pemuda.
Official cut-off times are 1h30 for 5K, 2h for 10K, 3h30 for the half marathon, and 7h for the full marathon.
The 2019 edition drew 5,200 runners, per the Surabaya city government; for the 2026 return the race chair reported almost 8,000 participants.

Course design is a 'City Run' concept through central Surabaya: the 2026 full marathon passed the Mayangkara Bridge, Jalan Ahmad Yani, Jalan HR Mohammad, Jalan Raya Darmo, Tugu Pahlawan, Jalan Rajawali and Jalan Tunjungan before finishing on Jalan Pemuda.
research_watchouts: The 2026 full marathon flagged off at 4:00am; the organiser asked runners to arrive at least 45 minutes before their start and allowed a 10-minute grace period to cross the start line.

The city cancelled its Car Free Day for the race and closed or diverted main roads, including Jalan Pemuda, Jalan Raya Darmo, Jalan Basuki Rahmat and Jalan Ahmad Yani, from early morning until near midday, so plan arrival accordingly.

Genuine participant race reports (independent of official/organiser or news-agency coverage) for the Surabaya Marathon brand specifically are scarce online, so course-condition and crowd-support details beyond official/press descriptions are limited.

faqs.question: Where is the Surabaya Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Surabaya Marathon 2026 is held in Surabaya, Indonesia, starting at Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya. This central venue serves as the starting point for all four race distances offered as part of the event.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at the Surabaya Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Surabaya Marathon 2026 offers four distance categories: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race, allowing runners of different experience levels to participate on the same event day.

faqs.question: What is the date of the Surabaya Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Surabaya Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on 2 August 2026 in Surabaya, Indonesia. Runners across all four distance categories will start from the same venue, Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya, on this date.
